source.task_prompt: Write a function to append the given list to the given tuples.

generation.text:
```python
def add_lists(list_to_add, tuple_to_add_to):
    """
    Appends the elements of the given list to the given tuple and returns a new tuple.

    :param list_to_add: List of elements to be added to the tuple.
    :param tuple_to_add_to: Tuple to which the list elements will be appended.
    :return: A new tuple with the list elements appended.
    """
    return tuple_to_add_to + tuple(list_to_add)
```
